property_name: Four Points by Sheraton Nagoya, Chubu International Airport
valuation_basis: Independent valuation by CBRE K.K. as at 31 December 2025, JPY 7,790 million, discounted cash flow method (Note 4); year-end valuation, distinct from the JPY 6,000m purchase price
note: First overseas acquisition; acquired the trust beneficial interest of FPN from Godo Kaisha Pothos, an unrelated third party. Purchase price JPY 6,000 million (~S$56.5m acquisition of investment property per cash flow; H-REIT Group adjusted purchase consideration S$10,511k at Stapled level reclassified to PPE). Funded by term loans (JPY 5.9bn), RCF (JPY 364.9m) and a 4-year TMK bond (JPY 0.5bn).
